## Resolve Variance

Stores one decision about one failing line on the invoice's varianceResolutions — reason REQUIRED (the resolution IS the audit line), one resolution per line (a change of mind is a new record, not an edit), and the invoice moves to 'matching' so the ladder shows it is being worked. Resolving computes nothing: the panel re-derives the match and treats resolved lines as non-blocking.

### Example

Natural target: the linked INV N-4471's freight line ('invoiced, not on PO'). INV N-4466 shows a stored short-pay resolution.

### Non-goals

No un-resolve. No actor identity: cards have no current user, so the decision's attribution is whatever the caller passes.
